sample_unit: LLM responses to topical NSAID questions

links.outcome: Readability of LLM responses (Flesch Reading Ease, Flesch-Kincaid Grade Level) versus recommended thresholds
links.effect: All four models exceeded recommended readability thresholds (9th-10th grade level); none met the PEMAT-P actionability standard.
links.quote: All models exceeded recommended readability thresholds (9th-10th grade level), and none met the actionability standard (≤ 33.5%).

screen.reason: The study empirically benchmarks the accuracy, readability, and actionability of multiple commercial LLMs on guideline-compliant recommendations for topical NSAID use without testing a specific organizational deployment practice or safeguard.
